GOT QUESTIONS?

What software do you use to edit?
+
I primarily work in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve for editing and color grading. For motion graphics, I use After Effects. I can work with any project format you send over.
How do I share my footage with you?
+
You can share footage via Google Drive, WeTransfer, Dropbox or Frame.io is also an option.
How many revisions do I get?
+
Each plan comes with a set number of revisions (2â€“3 depending on the package). Additional revisions are available at a small extra charge. I aim to nail it in fewer rounds.
Do you work with international clients?
+
Absolutely. I work with creators and brands from India, the US, UAE, and across Europe. Communication happens via email or WhatsApp, and we can adapt timelines to your timezone.
What's your payment process?
+
A 50% advance is required to start the project, with the remaining 50% upon final delivery. I accept UPI, Wise, and Bank transfers.
Can you create Reels/Shorts from long videos?
+
Yes! This is a popular add-on. I can extract the best moments from long-form content and repurpose them into high-performing short-form videos for Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
